instrument.signal: log Y (linear-light Y via room_exposure.srgb_to_linear/luminance_Y) inside the FaceLandmarker forehead polygon, same region/H/logY as wrinkle_bands.analyse
instrument.spectrum: rfft2 power |F|^2, radially AVERAGED (mean power per radial bin; differs from wrinkle's max-magnitude FFT prominence profile); empty radial bins (no samples on small patches) are linearly interpolated from populated neighbours, count recorded per image. NO smoothing: a Daniell +-4 amendment was tried and REVERTED because it buried the goal pore line (goal_body2 raw argmax bin 140, 4.6 px wavelength, matches the visible pores and the card title's finer-frequency premise) under the mottling bump (bin 37), flipping the fix direction against the card; raw numbers from the smoothing trial are superseded, retained in the launcher log only
instrument.caveat_goal_body2_near_tie: raw goal_body2 argmax bin 140 (30.22) beats bin 37 (29.76) by 1.5pc: the pore line vs the mottling bump. Title premise + visible ~5px pores + falsifier select 140; recorded as a fragility
instrument.frequency: cycles per face height H = ||P10-P152|| px; rfft grid normalised per axis (fx_H = kx*H/W, fy_H = ky*H/Hpatch); radial bins 1 cycle/H wide
instrument.pore_band_source: wrinkle's pore sigmas H/1500..H/130 via the Gaussian characteristic-frequency rule f = 1/(2*pi*sigma)
instrument.peak: argmax of mean power inside the band, parabolically refined on log-power; cycles/H
instrument.noise_floor: median mean-power over f in [0.9*f_hi, f_hi] of the PHOTO spectrum
instrument.falsifier: goal peak power >= 2.0x its photo floor (margin mirrors the wrinkle 2x-PRE prominence rule); else record and stop
